about.title: About Me
about.subtitle: Full Stack Developer & Scalable Web Solutions Specialist
about.p1: Although my academic background is in Law, my true passion and my 15+ year career are in technology. I specialize in designing robust web architectures, efficient business logic and high-performance user experiences, leveraging my analytical mindset to adapt quickly and deliver digital solutions that generate real value.
about.p2: Since 2007 I've worked in network administration and development, with a strong focus on Free Software (GNU/Linux). I presented on Free Software migration at UCIENCIA 2012.
about.p3: Today my focus is on creating solutions that help businesses grow, optimize their processes and make the most of digital opportunities. I care about understanding each problem before looking for a solution, using the most appropriate tools for each situation. I am also exploring new areas and possibilities with artificial intelligence, seeking not only to add value to every project, but also to keep growing and evolving as a professional.

location.title: Location & Work Mode
location.description:
I currently reside in Cuba and am available for remote, hybrid or on-site opportunities. I seek a long-term professional relationship where I can contribute my experience in software development, infrastructure and web technologies.

I am especially interested in opportunities that involve international relocation or work-visa sponsorship, although I am open to any professional proposal that represents a good collaboration opportunity.
